segments.text: what is power interest stakeholder
analysis all projects involved
stakeholders who are interested in the
project or are affected by the project
outcomes the project team need to work
closely with the stakeholders and take
account of their views where possible
however it can be difficult to decide
how much time and attention should be
given to each stakeholder no stakeholder
should be ignored completely but the
approach taken to engage with each
stakeholder will differ depending on two
factors first their level of interest in
the project and second the amount of
power or influence they wield with
regard to both the project work and
outcomes the power interest grid is a
technique you to analyze stakeholders
and determine the engagement strategy to
be applied when working with different
individuals or groups the power interest
grid is based upon two axes the y-axis
represents the level of power influenced
stakeholder has with regard to the
project while the x-axis represents the
level of interest the stakeholder has
with regard to the project stakeholders
are either plotted on the grid as
individuals or as groups senior managers
are likely to be considered as
individual stakeholders
whereas teams of business staff are more
likely to be considered as a group once
the stakeholders have been plotted on
the power interest grid we can decide
how to engage with each stakeholder
shown here are the appropriate
stakeholder management strategies to be
used depending on where the stakeholders
are placed on the grid starting at the
bottom we have those with no or low
interest and no or low power influence
the overall strategy is to ignore these
stakeholders for the time being however
as positions can change throughout the
course of a project it's probably wise
to inform them occasionally about what's
going on stakeholders with some more
high interest but no or low power
influence are an important group to
consider and manage as they are affected
by the changes but are likely to be
powerless to influence them therefore
the best strategy is to keep them
informed of the proposed changes and the
reasoning behind them
next we have stakeholders with no or low
to high interest but some power
influence we want to keep these
stakeholders onside the best approach is
to keep them supportive of the project
possibly through frequent positive
communication but perhaps also by
involving them more with the work of the
project at the top left of the grid we
have stakeholders with no or low
interest but high power influence these
stakeholders are usually at such a
senior level that the project is of
little interests them however ignoring
them is a risky approach because
external factors may rouse their
interest which might cause them to
intervene and exert their influence on
the project because of this we should
always keep an eye on them and if they
do become more interested in the project
we should address their needs directly
possibly through one-to-one meetings for
those with some interests in the project
and high power influence the usual
strategy is to keep them satisfied so
that they are happy with the progress
and allow the project to continue
without them taking a more direct and
potentially obstructive interest in the
project
however there may be circumstances where
their support would be helpful in which
case the strategy may be precisely the
opposite to engage these stakeholders so
that they are more actively involved in
the project the final stakeholder group
concerns those with high interest in the
project and high power influence these
are the key players the people who are
both interested in the project and have
the power to direct the work initially
we need to determine if they are
positive or negative in their approach
to the project if positive then their
enthusiasm and support must be sustained
and Exploited where necessary if they
are negatively inclined towards the
project influencing strategies will need
to be deployed a helpful approach is to
identify some benefits for them
personally from the project approach or
outcomes if this is impossible it will
be necessary to identify a more powerful
stakeholder who can help manage any
issues they raise stakeholder positions
are very likely to change over the
lifetime of the project for example
their interest main
as the project outcomes become clearer
or their power may increase because of
the change of job role anyone working on
a business change your IT project would
benefit from using the power interest
grid to help engage effectively with
stakeholders this should be done both at
the outset of the project and on an
ongoing basis thanks for watching this
video by assist KD for more videos like
this see our channel or check out our
website
